sleeve_replacement_rule.what: when a v9.8 / v9.9 sleeve is replaced (watch list: trend 4h, C*, relative crowding 6)

sleeve_replacement_rule.action: the sleeve's weight is halved (not dropped) and a replacement is searched with a NEW pre-registered protocol judged against the book WITHOUT the sleeve; one trigger check per month, no ad-hoc removal
